changed_files: src/cli.js (mcp command, --mcp bool flag, create/link now call lifecycle)
residual_risk: `claude mcp list` was not run: `claude` is not in the worker profile's allowlist, so the manual initialize + tools/list handshake stands in for it. Worth one run by hand before trusting the .mcp.json path end to end.
Only protocol versions 2025-06-18 / 2025-03-26 / 2024-11-05 are echoed back; anything else silently gets 2025-06-18 (spec-conformant, but the list needs updating as MCP revises).
resources/list and prompts/list answer -32601 rather than empty lists — correct per spec since neither capability is declared, but a noisy client may log it.

Moving create/link into lifecycle.js changed two --json payloads by addition: `hkb create --json` now returns the whole task on an idempotency-key hit, and `hkb link --json` gained `linked`. Supersets, but a script pinning exact keys would notice.
hkb doctor has no MCP check (out of scope): a .mcp.json pointing at an hkb that later leaves PATH fails at the client, not at doctor.
verification: npm test — 254 pass, 0 fail (28 new; no gh and no network: fake-gh is the transport, stdin/stdout are plain objects)

live stdio handshake against emyann/harness-kanban-board: initialize -> tools/list (9 tools) -> tools/call kanban_show 9, whose structuredContent deep-equals `hkb show 9 --json`; unknown tool -> -32602, unknown argument -> isError content, ping -> {}
hkb init --mcp file generation exercised through installMcp (writes .mcp.json, prints both snippets); the generated file was removed again, not committed

results.summary: hkb mcp: a stdio MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0 by hand, no dependency) exposing the nine verbs as kanban_* tools, each a wrapper of the same function cli.js calls. A tools/call of kanban_show is byte-for-byte `hkb show <n> --json` (asserted in test, verified live). `task` defaults to $KB_TASK; bad arguments and refused verbs come back as isError content so the model can read LOCK_LOST; the terminal verbs replay through the offline outbox. `hkb create` / `hkb link` moved out of the CLI switch into lifecycle.js as createTask/linkTask so there is one code path (CLI --json gained fields, no behaviour change). `hkb init --mcp` merges .mcp.json without clobbering other servers and prints the Codex (~/.codex/config.toml) and VS Code (.vscode/mcp.json) snippets, which are not hkb's files to write; with hkb off PATH the config names process.execPath + bin/hkb.js absolutely on both halves. No .mcp.json is committed for this repo on purpose: the dispatcher spawns workers with --permission-mode dontAsk and no mcp__* in the allowlist, so a project-level server here would be noise for every worker. Draft PR #38.
